cards.text: Out in the wilderness, Miriam and Aaron start criticizing Moses, Israel's leader and their own brother (Numbers 26:59). Family, friend. NOBODY knows where to aim like family.

cards.question: Miriam and Aaron are criticizing their brother Moses. What's it about?

answers.text: The way he led them out

cards.text: Then the two of them say out loud what's on their minds. And it's all about who the LORD talks through.

cards.question: What are Miriam and Aaron saying about the LORD?

answers.text: He has stopped speaking at all
He only speaks through the elders

cards.question: True or false: Miriam and Aaron's complaint about Moses stays just between the two of them.

cards.text: The LORD heard them, friend. That's finding out the boss was in the group chat the WHOLE time.

cards.question: Right here the passage stops to tell us something about Moses himself. What does it say?

answers.text: He was the most humble man on earth
He was the bravest man on earth
He was the wisest man on earth

cards.text: The most humble man on earth. And here I am bragging to the oven every time a stamp comes out clean. Then suddenly the LORD tells all three of them to come out.

cards.question: Where does the LORD tell Moses, Aaron and Miriam to come out to?

cards.text: So the three go out, and the LORD comes down in a pillar of cloud and stands at the entrance to the Tent. Then He calls two of them forward.

cards.question: Which two does the LORD call forward at the entrance to the Tent?

cards.text: Aaron and Miriam step forward, and nobody gets called up front by name for good news. Then the LORD says if there's a prophet among them, He'll reveal Himself in a vision and speak in a dream.

cards.question: Then the LORD talks about His servant Moses. True or false: He says Moses is faithful in all His house.
A prophet gets visions and dreams. How does the LORD say He speaks with Moses?

cards.text: Then the LORD asks them, "Why then were you unafraid to speak against My servant Moses?" That's not a question you answer, friend. That's one you just stand there and FEEL.

cards.question: Before the LORD departs from the Tent, what happens toward Miriam and Aaron?

answers.text: He calls Moses to judge them
He lets the whole thing go

cards.text: As the cloud lifts from above the Tent, suddenly Miriam is leprous, white as snow. Aaron turns toward her and sees it, and I bet his heart hits the floor.

cards.question: Aaron sees that Miriam is leprous. Who does he plead with?
Aaron begs Moses not to hold against them the sin they so ___ committed.

cards.text: Then Aaron pleads for Miriam: please don't let her be like a stillborn infant whose flesh is half consumed. That's not a man picking his words, friend, that's a brother BEGGING.

cards.question: Aaron is pleading with Moses, the same brother Miriam just criticized. What does Moses do?

answers.text: Cries out to God to heal her
Tells Aaron to pray for her instead
Asks the elders to decide for him

cards.text: Five words from Moses: "O God, please heal her!" No speech, no told-you-so. Then the LORD answers with a question: if her father had only spit in her face, wouldn't she be in disgrace?

cards.question: How long does the LORD say Miriam must be confined outside the camp?
True or false: The LORD says that after her seven days outside the camp, Miriam may be brought back in.
While Miriam is confined outside the camp for seven days, the people ___ until she is brought in again.

cards.text: After that, the people set out from Hazeroth and camp in the Wilderness of Paran, with Miriam back among them. After years in a junk drawer, friend, I can tell you being brought back in is the BEST feeling.

findings.problem: The setup line says their complaint is "all about who the LORD talks through." That rules out the wrong answer "He has stopped speaking at all" on card 4 before the baker picks.

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

findings.problem: This card only restates what card 5 just answered (the LORD heard them) and adds a joke. It doesn't move the passage forward. The joke could ride on the next card that tells new material instead.

rule.text: Every story card moves the baker forward through the passage.

findings.problem: This story card has three sentences ("The most humble man on earth." / "And here I am bragging..." / "Then suddenly the LORD tells..."). Only the opening card can go past two.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: This story card has three sentences: the quote, "That's not a question you answer, friend." and "That's one you just stand there and FEEL."

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: Earlier setup lines signal punishment: card 12 says "nobody gets called up front by name for good news" and card 15 says "That's one you just stand there and FEEL." Together they rule out the wrong answer "He lets the whole thing go."

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

findings.problem: This story card has three sentences: the quote of Moses, "No speech, no told-you-so." and the LORD's answer. It also carries three beats.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The comparison says that after the junk drawer, "being brought back in" is the best feeling. But Papa Dorin was never brought back in. He was called out of the drawer into the Dorinverse. The action doesn't match his backstory, and it implies something new about it.

rule.text: The everyday comparison must have the same action.
